tables.name: Hjartheland Naming Method
tables.description: Eight editable Nordic/winter-inspired methods, using d100 with explicit 22/20/21/10/9/11/4/3 percent allocation. All data is provisional and editable; not historical linguistic reconstruction.

results.name: Traditional Settlement Compound
results.description: Old farmstead, hamlet and settlement place-name elements, with a broad inherited geographic vocabulary.

results.name: Mountains, Ridges & Valleys
results.description: Landforms and elevated locations, including steep climbs, exposed highland valleys and ridge communities.

results.name: Snow, Glaciers & Winter
results.description: Seasonal and permanent ice, glaciers, snowfields and weathered winter geography.

results.name: Rivers, Lakes & Fjords
results.description: Lakes, frozen channels, waterways and older fjord/coastal naming traditions.

results.name: Forest, Moor & Pasture
results.description: Boreal forest settlements, heath, mossland and seasonal upland farm clearings.

results.name: Shelter & Winter Routes
results.description: Shelters, mountain roads, ferries, halls and dependable resting sites important to hospitality.

results.name: Historical Homestead
results.description: Older landholding/farm names using simplified genitive founder stems; only a small proportion of the final mix.

results.name: Ancient Inherited Name
results.description: A complete place name of uncertain or archaic origin: not assembled from modern component tables.
